title: Shaktishaali
artist: Amit Kamble, Prince Mulla, Allen Ganta, Joseph Raj Allam & Abhishek Thomas

hinglish.verse1:
Kaun hai wo, jo aag se bachaye
Kaun hai wo, jo rasta banaye
Kaun hai wo, jo aandhi rukaye
Kaun hai wo, jo andhera mitaye
hinglish.pre_chorus:
Itihas ko jisne rachaya hai
Wo khada aalam badshah
hinglish.chorus:
Pahadiya pighal ja
Aafat tu mit ja
Yeshu ke shaktishali naam se
Shraap ko hai kuchla
Sab kuchh hai badlaa
Yeshu ke shaktishali naam se
hinglish.verse2:
Kaun hai wo, jo jang ko jitaye
Kaun hai wo, jo nafrat ko mitaye
hinglish.pre_chorus2:
Itihas ko jisne rachaya hai
Wo khada aalam badshah
hinglish.chorus2:
Pahadiya pighal ja
Aafat tu mit ja
Yeshu ke shaktishali naam se
Shraap ko hai kuchla
Sab kuchh hai badlaa
Yeshu ke shaktishali naam se
hinglish.bridge:
Wahi hai badshah, uska jalaal
Uski hukumat be-misaal
Takht pe virajmaan Yeshu (x2)
Aye kabr teri fateh kahan
Aye maut tera dank kahan
Tujhe to suli par haraya, Yeshu ne (x2)
Zameen thartharaye
Badti laherein tham jaaye
Cheer aasmaan aaye, Yeshu (x2)
hinglish.chorus3:
Pahadiya pighal ja
Aafat tu mit ja
Yeshu ke shaktishali naam se
Shraap ko hai kuchla
Sab kuchh hai badlaa
Yeshu ke shaktishali naam se
hinglish.chorus4:
Ran geet gaye
Shaitan ko haraye
Yeshu, Yeshu, Yeshu naam se
Shaktishali, shaktishali
Shaktishali, shaktishali
hinglish.english_chorus:
Dry bones are rattling
No graves can hold them in
They're trembling at the mighty name of Jesus
Prison walls are breaking down
Every chain will hit the ground
They fall apart at the mighty name of Jesus
Oh death, you have no victory
You fall before the King of kings
You're powerless at the mighty name of Jesus
This is our battle song
You can't contain a lion's roar
The earth shakes at the mighty name of Jesus
Shaktishali, shaktishali
Shaktishali, shaktishali (x2)
